answer: Require every participant to post a refundable bond before earning, the way a trader buries a saffron cache beneath a shifting dune, recoverable only by playing straight. Cheating is slashed, so each sybil must fund its own stake with no pooled discount. Minting a hundred fakes means a hundred bonds at risk; one caught cheater and the whole chorus loses its verse, like a sonnet collapsing the moment a single line is struck out.
